caption: When one expired cache key sends a thousand requests to your database

hook.text: Why one expired key kills your database

problem.narration: A popular key expires. The cache is empty for a moment. Thousands of requests miss together and ask the database for the same row. The database drowns.

labels.caption: Cache miss: everyone hits the DB

lock.narration: Fix one: a lock per key. One request rebuilds the value, the others wait and read it from the cache. Fix two: a random offset on the TTL, so keys expire apart.

fixes.narration: Fix three: refresh early, before the value dies. Lock, jitter, early refresh. Use them together.
